summary: Farm Frites is an independent family business that makes frozen and chilled fries, potato specialties and appetizers, mainly for foodservice. It is based in Oudenhoorn, the Netherlands, and was founded in 1971 by farmer Gerrit de Bruijne. It says it processes 1.5 million tonnes of potatoes every year.
products: Chef's Harvest and Chef's Specials Crispy Coated fries
Home-Style, Fast Fry and Quick Oven fries
markets: Products served in more than 100 countries
facts: Transforms 1.5 million tonnes of potatoes every year
Works with over 750 potato growers in the Netherlands, Belgium, Poland and Egypt
More than 80 types of fries, potato specialties and appetizers
